identification: Six glass pieces, unsigned in photos: (1) Fenton-style opalescent hobnail cornucopia vase with clear foot; (2) Murano white/pink bird with gold aventurine wings and base (Seguso/Barovier-style, 1950s-60s); (3) Murano murrine/millefiori top-hat vase, white with black and red eyes; (4) Murano opalescent white cornucopia with gold aventurine tail and fin, Seguso-style; (5) Murano controlled-bubble (bullicante) pale pink/white vase with gold fleck, footed; (6) white and clear ruffled glass bowl/vase, one orange stain mark on the white section. viewing_check: Estimate 80-120, current bid $30 (+22% premium). Ask for the bird chip location and look for paper labels or polished pontil marks on the Murano pieces (an Archimede Seguso or Barovier attribution would lift the price). Unsigned Murano cornucopias sell roughly A$83-120 each, the bird about A$77-190 depending on the model, the hobnail piece about A$35-60 and the top hat has no AU sales found. Prices are 2024-2026 and stable. Selling the six separately could total roughly A$350-500 but the bird is chipped.
